}}'''Jaichim Carridin''' was an officer of the [[Children of the Light]] and an [[Inquisitor]] of the [[Hand of the Light]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Jaichim Carridin}} He commanded the Questioners in [[Tarabon]]. His second was [[Einor Saren]]. He was also a high ranking [[Darkfriend]], known to his fellows by the name '''Bors'''{{ref/book|2|p}}.

== Appearance ==
He was tall with gray at his temples. He was hard faced with dark, hard, deep-set eyes{{ref/book|2|p}}.

== History ==
Jaichim Carridin was described as a very patient and cunning man. As an Inquisitor he was ruthless, as a Friend of the Dark he was worse. Carridin was from a large noble family in [[Amadicia]]. He had an intense hatred of [[Tuatha'an|Tinkers]].

==Activities==
=== Bors ===
Carridin first appeared as the man known then only as '''Bors''', at the [[Darkfriend Social]]. He was ordered by [[Ishamael]] to keep a watch for three country lads, [[Perrin Aybara]], [[Matrim Cauthon]], and [[Rand al'Thor]], and to report if they were found. Ishamael also ordered him to take the Children into [[Almoth Plain]] and create chaos. He was also told to keep anything he heard about the [[Seanchan]] quiet and minimize their importance{{ref/book|2|p}}.

He used [[Pedron Niall]]'s plan to seize Almoth Plain to this end{{ref/book|2|5}}. Niall sent [[Geofram Bornhald]] to assist him. Carridin began using the Children to create havoc on the plain. Bornhald aided him at first but soon realized that the true threat was the Seanchan. Defying Carridin's orders, he led his legion to [[Falme]] to confront the Seanchan{{ref/book|2|29}}.

[[File:Jaichim Carridin.jpg|thumb|left|Jaichim talking to a Myrddraal]]

=== Demise of his family ===
After the disaster at Falme, Carridin was recalled to [[Amador]] by Pedron Niall. He was rebuked for his inaction against the Seanchan and told to keep Rand al'Thor alive. After this meeting he was given orders by [[Shaidar Haran]] to kill Rand or Carridin's family would be killed one by one, with him last{{ref/book|tdr|p}}.

Carridin returned to Tarabon and continued looking for Rand. When he failed to find him, reports started coming in that [[Myrddraal]] were killing members of his family.
Using his few hundred soldiers, he is able to attain a position of power and influence in Tarabon{{ref/book|3|31}}.

=== Tanchico ===
Carridin negotiated with King Andric and several other Taraboner lords to take control of the Panarch's Palace for Amathera. When [[Liandrin]] and her associates arrived in [[Tanchico]], he became involved with them. He was ordered to place his men at the [[Panarch]]'s [[Panarch's Palace|Palace]] to help create confusion and unrest{{ref/book|4|38}}. But Liandrin also gave him orders conflicting with those he had previously received, to no longer hunt Rand. Carridin began drinking brandy heavily around this time{{ref/book|4|39}}.

Carridin and the Whitecloaks took control of the Panarch's Palace{{ref/book|4|51}}. They question Bayle Domon when he arrived at the Palace, but they allowed him to have his 'helpers' bring in a load of ice peppers{{ref/book|4|54}}. Outside the Palace the Whitecloaks were crushed by a rioting mob lead by Bayle Domon's men{{ref/book|4|55}}.

=== Ebou Dar ===
He returned to Amador and received orders to head to Altara, and organise false Dragonsworn to plague the country {{ref/book|6|p}}. When Niall learned that Elayne was in the Tarasin palace, Carridin was ordered to snatch her {{ref/book|7|15}}. Carridin sent a note to Elayne through Tylin. The note offered to take her to Amador where Morgase was a guest of Pedron Niall. Elayne thinks it is a lie and is infuriated{{ref/book|7|30}}.

Eventually Carridin came to serve [[Sammael]]. Sammael sent him to [[Ebou Dar]] to find a cache of ''[[angreal]]'' and ''[[ter'angreal]]'', which included the [[Bowl of the Winds]]. While there he hired a Darkfriend assassin named [[Lady Shiaine]]. When Sammael came to check on progress, Carridin noticed Matrim Cauthon and suddenly remembered a secret mission given to him to kill Mat. Sammael told him to forget Cauthon and search for the ''angreal''{{ref/book|7|15}}. Carridin disobeyed Sammael and sent Shiaine after him. Carridin failed again.

Carridin was murdered by being drowned in brandy by [[Murellin]] in the house on Full Moon Street in [[Caemlyn]]. Lady Shiaine ordered this done by the command of [[Moridin]]{{ref/book|8|28}}.
